categories.main_business_segments: Lianyou Metals Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the recycling and refining of tungsten and cobalt metals. The company produces sodium tungstate, cobalt sulfate, calcium tungstate, cobalt carbonate, and other cobalt derivatives using recycled secondary hard alloys and tungsten-cobalt resources. It also engages in the development of downstream products such as battery-grade cobalt chemicals and high-value tungsten products. The subsidiary, Lianyou Energy Technology, focuses on powder metallurgy and cobalt product refinement.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary low-energy, environmentally friendly patented technologies for metal recovery and refining, including metal oxidation mechanisms, drying devices for metal salts, and cobalt and tungsten recovery from secondary hard alloys. It has developed advanced methods for powder processing of aerospace alloys and tungsten-copper alloys, as well as metal separation and enrichment techniques for rare metals like tantalum, niobium, and silver. The production process emphasizes circular economy principles and high recovery rates.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lianyou Metals serves international tungsten and cobalt metal smelters, lithium battery material manufacturers, and industrial users of tungsten and cobalt products. Key customers include global companies in the automotive, electronics, aerospace, and defense sectors. The company has established cooperation with major international tungsten companies and targets markets in the US, Europe, Japan, and Taiwan. It also supplies battery-grade cobalt products to domestic and foreign manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with its headquarters and factory located in Pingtung County. It exports products globally, with significant sales in the United States, Europe, Japan, and other international markets. The company plans to establish production and marketing bases in Europe and the US to reduce carbon footprint and tariffs. Its supply chain and customer base are international, reflecting a global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lianyou Metals operates in the midstream segment of the tungsten and cobalt supply chain, focusing on recycling and refining secondary raw materials into high-purity metal compounds. It sources secondary hard alloys and recycled tungsten-cobalt materials and supplies refined metal products to downstream manufacturers such as battery and alloy producers. The company also engages in developing downstream high-value products, moving closer to end-product manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in refining and recycling technologies for tungsten and cobalt, including battery-grade cobalt chemicals and advanced metal separation techniques. It focuses on expanding product lines to include ammonium paratungstate, tungsten oxide, tungsten powder, and cobalt powders. Future R&D includes aerospace alloy recycling, lithium battery recycling, and development of high-value downstream products. The company also emphasizes sustainability, circular economy, and carbon reduction initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Lianyou Metals generates revenue primarily through the sale of refined tungsten and cobalt metal compounds and derivatives. It also earns income from processing fees for recycling secondary raw materials. The company’s revenue is derived from product sales to international metal smelters, battery material manufacturers, and industrial users. It plans to increase revenue by expanding production capacity and introducing higher-margin battery-grade cobalt products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the top five global players outside China in tungsten recycling capacity and is the largest specialized tungsten recycling company outside the Chinese market. It competes with international firms in the US, Europe, Japan, and other countries that use chemical or zinc smelting methods. Due to high technical and capital barriers, Lianyou holds a competitive advantage with its proprietary low-energy, environmentally friendly technologies and established international partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Lianyou Metals reported revenues of approximately NT$1.1 billion, a 20% increase from the previous year, driven mainly by increased sales volume of sodium tungstate. The company’s net profit significantly improved to NT$58.7 million from NT$4 million in 2022. Total assets grew by 21.9% to NT$1.89 billion, with increased investments in property, plant, and equipment. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding production capacity and product diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lianyou Metals differentiates itself by being Taiwan’s first and only company with proprietary recycling technology that converts secondary hard alloys and tungsten-cobalt resources into high-purity metal compounds using low-energy, environmentally friendly processes. It emphasizes circular economy principles, sustainability, and high recovery rates, certified by international standards. The company’s ability to produce battery-grade cobalt products and develop downstream high-value tungsten and cobalt materials positions it as a strategic partner in the global tungsten and cobalt supply chain.
